overview: You wrote Anne that she was to pay nothing on your father's account until you come. The page is harsher than a bill of fourteen shillings and sixpence. It is dated in the old year, and it is not the letter you will keep.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the page and left it beside the candle.

assets.name: 14s 6d at the whittawer's
assets.disposition: Wrote a cold answer and left it by the candle

important_dates.meaning: The answer that was too sharp
